faq:
Frequently Asked Questions

What should the best salon interior designer in Karnal deliver?

A salon that looks premium, is easy for staff to work in and is comfortable for clients. That means good layout, lighting, ventilation and durable finishes.

Can you design unisex salons?

Yes. We plan separate or shared zones for men and women, with privacy where it is needed and a common reception and waiting area.

Do you design bridal and makeup studios?

Yes. Bridal studios need bright, even lighting, large mirrors, comfortable seating for family members and a private changing area.

Why hire the best salon interior designer for a first salon?

A first salon has a fixed budget and no room for mistakes. Careful planning makes sure money goes into things clients notice and staff use every day.
